note: SIMULATED assessor. Its signing identity is the simulated-assessor.yml workflow in this repository (called by the deploy as a reusable workflow, so its Sigstore certificate names that workflow, not the deploy). It is not independent of the provider, not a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service, and has no FedRAMP assessor ID. Replacing it with a real assessor means pinning that assessor's own identity here in a reviewed change.
